title: InstallationIdentity
description: Per-cell identity of what was actually installed and loaded (03-data-schema.md § InstallationIdentity). A cache version label and an install command's exit code are not byte proof; a digest/version/load mismatch is could-not-run installation-identity-mismatch.

requested_cli_version.description: Exact CLI version requested from pins.json (pinned track) or the run-resolved newest version.

resolved_cli_version.description: Exact CLI version resolved once before fan-out.

observed_cli_version.description: Version the installed CLI reported, normalized to a dotted version. null when no CLI was observed.

expected_plugin_manifest_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the expected plugin manifest built from sorted relative paths and file contents.
